title: MLZ landing zone
description: A layer of landing zone settings: landing-zones/_defaults/all.yaml, _defaults/<env>.yaml, <workload>/_workload.yaml or <workload>/<env>.yaml. Each says only what differs from the one above.

owner.description: The owning team's email address. Becomes the Owner tag, and gets the budget alerts unless budget.contacts names others.

cost_center.description: The cost center. Becomes the CostCenter tag.

archetype.description: The management group the subscription goes into: corp, online or sandbox (local only when governance turns it on).

location.description: The Azure region, one of governance's allowed regions with a hub, for example norwayeast.

subscription.description: The landing zone's subscription ID, handed to vending before this file is merged.

monthly.description: A whole amount per month, in the subscription's currency. No monthly, no budget.

contacts.description: Who gets the budget alerts, as email addresses (default: the owner).

network.description: The spoke network. Its addresses come from the IP allocator, in _generated/ip-plan.yaml, never from here.

size.description: The range's prefix length, from 16 to 28. The IP allocator gives out the block.

subnets.description: Each subnet's name to its prefix length, up to 29 (default: one subnet, default, a /26 or the whole of a smaller range).

organization.description: The GitHub organization of the landing zone's repo. Set it once, in _defaults/all.yaml.

repo.description: The landing zone's repo, whose main branch signs in as its deploy identity.

decommission.description: true retires this landing zone: its plan destroys everything vending made and moves the subscription to Decommissioned. Only in the landing zone's own file.

tags.description: Extra tags. Owner, CostCenter, Environment, Workload and ManagedBy are set for you.
